g.text: A campus-wide directory of every student organization at Xavier University – Ateneo de Cagayan.
Search, filter, and visit any booth without leaving your seat.
Booths trending during Club Fair Week at Xavier Ateneo.
For students who love to build.
Every org lives under one cluster.
The ten Xavier Ateneo clusters are grouped into four
Google puzzle-piece hues so you can scan the whole
roster at a glance. Combine two chips on Browse to
intersect them — find only the orgs at the meeting point.
Prototype · Ready for the Figma "Website Prototype" rebuild
